Other members of our team finished—21 Eric Herbert, 23 Tom Morrell, 25 Stan Eales, 32 Syd Jarlett, 39 Con Abberton, 42 Gordon Doubleday. The team championship resulted—1 Belgrave Harriers 45 points; 2 Herne Hill H. 74 points; 3 Surrey A.C. 101 points.

Held on the same day as the above fixture, as owing to the club "Open" walk, no runners are allowed at Wimbledon, our vice-captain Bert Smith took along a mixed team to run against the local club at Perivale. Arthur Bruce was our first man home in second position, with Con Abberton 6, Bert Footer 7, Bert Smith 8, K.

The sealed handicap was won by that "old war-horse" Harry Shields, who battled through to the end, with Eric Herbert, maintaining his recent improved form, taking second award, and Con Abberton beating his brother Frank for third prize.

Dick Towndrow won the 15 miles road race promoted by the Wigmore Harriers, and Geoff Pearson and Con Abberton finished equal fifth. In the Finchley "20" Geoff Pearson was 17th in 2 hrs. 13 mins. 31 secs., quite a creditable effort.
